intro_text: Exam 9 covers a wide range of material related to enterprise risk management. The syllabus is divided into three pieces: The first is memorization heavy on ERM techniques. The second is calculation heavy on reinsurance. The third (and newest) is a blend of memorization and calculation on quantifying and allocating risk capital. Our study guide will help you efficiently master the numerous calculations and balance this with drilling the key concepts you need to memorize. With original and CAS problems complete with step-by-step solutions, BattleActs will position you to score big on exam day.
